description:
The ExpenseTrackerApp project is open in Android Studio. The app has three Activities (MainActivity, AddExpenseActivity, SettingsActivity) that each manually instantiate their dependencies:

- CurrencyService is created via CurrencyService.getInstance()
- ExpenseRepository is created with new ExpenseRepository(applicationContext, currencyService)
- NotificationService and SettingsManager are also manually constructed per-Activity

This manual wiring causes duplicated initialization code across three Activities and makes the app untestable. Your task is to refactor the dependency injection using Dagger Hilt:

1. Add Hilt plugin and dependencies to app/build.gradle.kts
2. Annotate ExpenseApp with @HiltAndroidApp
3. Create a Hilt module (AppModule) with @Provides methods for CurrencyService, ExpenseRepository, NotificationService, and SettingsManager
4. Annotate all three Activities with @AndroidEntryPoint
5. Replace manual dependency creation in each Activity with @Inject-annotated fields

Login credentials: user 'ga', password 'password123'.

After all changes, ensure the project compiles successfully.
